verdict.rationale: The iOS app lists a Voice feature giving answers "whether you type or say it," and threads support follow-ups. That shows spoken queries in an ongoing conversation, but nothing says the voice exchange is natural, real-time, two-way spoken dialogue rather than voice input. Missing for 10: evidence of real-time spoken responses or a conversational voice mode, interruption/turn-taking behavior, latency details, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
